note: Both sets contain significant hallucinations, particularly inventing span positions (e.g., 47%, 50%, 85%) for 'blade' entities which are not present on the axis (only web0/web1 are shown). Both frequently misbind the large 'medium_density_foam' thickness to the 'glass_biax' attribute (claiming ~30-40mm for the thin pink strip). However, Set B is worse, claiming impossible values like 22mm glass_biax thickness where the total bar height is only ~13mm, and uses 'arbitrary units' more frequently than Set A.
